title: Kitchen hood exhaust and makeup air interlock (custom, job-specific)

sources.document: Project specification 23 09 93, kitchen hood exhaust interlock (contractor upload)
sources.edition: fixture text in the style of a specification section; the contractor approves it

points.name: uAhuFan
points.label: Building AHU supply fan status (bound from AHU_1.y1SupFan)

requirements.title: Hood exhaust fan follows the hood switch
requirements.text: The hood exhaust fan shall start when the kitchen hood switch is on and stop when it is off.

citation.document: Project specification 23 09 93, kitchen hood exhaust interlock (contractor upload)

requirements.title: Makeup air runs with the hood while the AHU runs
requirements.text: The makeup air fan shall run whenever the hood exhaust fan is running and the building air handling unit supply fan is in operation; the makeup air damper shall open with the makeup air fan.

citation.document: Project specification 23 09 93, kitchen hood exhaust interlock (contractor upload)

requirements.title: Makeup air fan failure alarm
requirements.text: If the makeup air fan is commanded on and its proof is not made within 45 seconds, a makeup air failure alarm shall be generated; the alarm shall clear when proof is made or the command is removed.

citation.document: Project specification 23 09 93, kitchen hood exhaust interlock (contractor upload)

requirements.title: Hood off stops the makeup air
requirements.text: When the hood switch is off, the hood exhaust fan, the makeup air fan and damper, and the failure alarm shall be off.

citation.document: Project specification 23 09 93, kitchen hood exhaust interlock (contractor upload)

invariants.text: Makeup air never runs without the hood

citation.document: Project specification 23 09 93, kitchen hood exhaust interlock (contractor upload)

invariants.text: The damper opens with the makeup fan

citation.document: Project specification 23 09 93, kitchen hood exhaust interlock (contractor upload)

notes: Custom, job-specific sequence (Tier 5). Composed with the Tier 1 AHU through the project signal binding AHU_1.y1SupFan -> HOOD_1.uAhuFan.
